Magento Ecommerce

Accelerate your website with us.

Get a quoteCall 01603 407786

Broadland Digital has been producing Magento ecommerce solutions for many years. Our Magento specialists have designed and developed many ecommerce websites selling both products and services to business and customers alike. Our customers include trade based systems, retailers and well as large corporations. With our highly experienced team of developers, designers and strategists we are able to provide an innovative approach to Magento ecommerce development. Our experience in all areas of ecommerce from design, marketing, development and search engine optimization means that our clients can have a complete end-to-end solution for their business. We understand the importance of having a bespoke ecommerce website and our team of experts will make sure that your website is the perfect fit for your business. Our range of services includes Magento ecommerce theme development, custom Magento extensions, integrations with third party websites, mobile application development and more.

What are our selling points?

  • Bespoke design and creative so your website is unique to you;
  • Fully customisable frontend and administration panel to match to very specific criteria;
  • Ability to manage multiple sites from one admin interface;
  • System integration into warehouse stock management, fulfilment and accountancy packages;
  • Fully administrated marketing and merchandising tools including; discount coding, trade accounts & data feeds into shopping platforms;
  • Extensive statistics, including analytics and reports for both sales and traffic;
  • Hosted internally on optimised ecommerce servers with full support;
  • SEO optimised pages ready for PPC and Organic SEO campaigns, talk to one of our specialists;
  • Full dedicated support and ticketing system.
